# S-001 — a canonical `argus up` fixture scenario

This file exists only so `argus up`'s tests have a non-empty scenarios folder to point
`--scenarios-dir` at (cmd/argus/testdata/up-json-transcript/scenarios), a SIBLING of
product/argus-config.yaml rather than nested under it — onboard.sh's own D4 holdout guard
(onboard.sh:2229-2231) refuses a scenarios folder nested under the product folder.
